Since high centrifugal force is applied in RPB instead of gravity in RPB, higher mass transfer coefficients and a significant size reduction can be obtained.

It receives pressure and temperature signals from flow measurement sensors, detecting changes in pressure and temperature corresponding to fluid flow. Utilizing this pressure and temperature information, it predicts the flow rate. Typically, data is converted into a 4-20mA current signal for transmission, which is a standard communication protocol used in industrial measurement and control devices. • composite sensor A composite sensor is a sensor that collects both ultrasonic and pressure data. When the ultrasonic sensor fails to accurately measure the distance due to sludge or other objects, the pressure sensor detects changes in fluid pressure to predict the flow rate. The composite sensor adapts flexibly to physical changes, ensuring reliable flow rate measurements. • Monitoring System A monitoring system consists of a data acquisition board and a monitoring panel. NI는 소프트웨어를 통해 엔지니어를 연결한다는 아이디어 에서 40년 전에 시작되었습니다. NI는 혁신적인 기술의 테스트/측정을 가속화하기 위해 기기를 컴퓨터에 연결하는 기술을 개발했으며, 이것이 오늘날 비즈니스 운영의 원동력이 될 혁신의 씨앗이었습니다.
